name: kopybook-connect
title: Kopybook COBOL Copybook Converter and SMT
description:
Decode mainframe EBCDIC records into typed Kafka Connect Structs using the COBOL copybook, then let AvroConverter, ProtobufConverter or JsonSchemaConverter register a proper schema.

Supports zoned decimal (all sign forms), COMP-3, COMP/COMP-4/BINARY (TRUNC STD or BIN), COMP-5, COMP-1/COMP-2 IBM hex float, OCCURS and OCCURS DEPENDING ON, REDEFINES (all views, or select the view by a record-type field or 88-level), COPY ... REPLACING, level 66/88, FILLER, fixed and free source format, RDW framing, and EBCDIC code pages cp037, cp1140, cp500, cp273, cp1047 and others. Decimals keep exact precision and scale (Connect Decimal with connect.decimal.precision).

Ships as a Converter (decode and encode) and as Value/Key SMTs that work behind any source delivering bytes (MirrorSource, MQ, S3, SFTP). No runtime dependencies beyond the Kafka Connect API. Tested against a public 43-case golden corpus and end to end with Kafka, Schema Registry and Connect.

Limitations: SYNCHRONIZED, national/DBCS (PIC N/G), PIC P scaling and REDEFINES of variable-length data are rejected with a clear error.
